nodes.label: The co-simulation and native solvers agree to within sampling: their trial-me...
nodes.statement: The co-simulation and native solvers agree to within sampling: their trial-mean difference is 0.75× the combined statistical error (<1.5), so decomposing the hybrid solver into process-bigraph processes does not change the answer. Reaching this required two documented VCell fixes in the native path (no-op jump process virtualcell/vcell#2158; zero-reactant mass-action leak).

nodes.label: Open observation (not a gated test): both solvers show the same small margina...
nodes.statement: Open observation (not a gated test): both solvers show the same small marginal minimum KS p against the well-mixed reference — 7.70·10⁻⁴ (co-sim) and 6.87·10⁻⁴ (native). The effect is shared across solvers, so it is not a co-simulation artifact; a plausible cause is residual spatial structure (local U at an open channel slightly exceeds the volume mean).

Finite diffusion (Tests 4–5): the co-simulation matches the direct Fokker–Pla...
nodes.statement: Finite diffusion (Tests 4–5): the co-simulation matches the direct Fokker–Planck solutions to within sampling noise in every cell — reduced χ² = 0.54 (Test 4, x₀), 0.80 (Test 4, x₁) and 0.80 / 0.89 / 0.86 (Test 5, x₀/x₁/x₂), all inside [0, 2]. Relative L2 differences (1.0–1.6%) are smaller than the paper's (1.9% / 3.3% for Test 4).

nodes.label: DIVERGENCE (failed primary): in the fast-diffusion regime (Test 3) the co-sim...
nodes.statement: DIVERGENCE (failed primary): in the fast-diffusion regime (Test 3) the co-simulation's reduced χ² against Eq 4 is 2.48, just over the [0, 2] band, so test3-cosim-matches-fokker-planck FAILS. The native VCell arm sits just under at 1.82 (passes). Both solvers share the same small 0.58% relative-L2 bias (about twice the 0.30% sampling noise), so the gap belongs to the spatial hybrid at Δτ = 0.002, not to the co-simulation.

The Test 3 gap is a first-order time-discretization error, not a model error:...
nodes.statement: The Test 3 gap is a first-order time-discretization error, not a model error: the mean-bias fit offset + slope·Δτ gives a slope of −0.51 ± 0.06 and an offset of −0.044% ± 0.027%, consistent with zero (passes [−0.001, 0.001]). Native VCell at Δτ = 0.002 matches the fit's prediction, confirming the bias scales with Δτ and vanishes as Δτ → 0.
